Hi Samir —

Quick technical note ahead of the session: a 50k-doc embeddings ingest is straightforward in the sandbox if each document is under ~100KB. For cost-efficiency we’ll demo:

- Chunking heuristics (recommended overlap, chunk size ~1k–2k tokens)
- Batch sizes to aim for (we’ll show safe defaults and a throughput curve for our cheapest quantized variant)
- KV-cache is not relevant for embeddings; we’ll focus on prefix caching for generation flows if you try chat later.

If you can drop a 5-doc sample into the Drive link in my earlier CC, I’ll preload an index we can test during the call — that will save 10–15 minutes.

I’m good to join the 2:00–2:30pm PST slot today — Ava, please go ahead and send the invite.
